title: Respiratory visits (daily, by district)
summary: Daily count of respiratory clinic visits aggregated by district in Valdena (northern Italy), from 2022-01-01 onwards. The table contains no patient identifiers \u2014 only visit_date, district and visit_count. It is refreshed daily and was last refreshed on 2026-10-14. Per the clinic data policy for surveillance (last edited 2025-02-01), this is the only clinic visits table permitted for this analysis; patient-level records and age/postcode fields are explicitly prohibited. Covers the full production window (2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31).

schema.notes: Simple schema: one row per district per day.

spatial.notes: District boundaries may have changed during the production window — the catalog does not document which version of district boundaries is used. This could affect join consistency with other sources using district codes.
